meta.title: WoW WotLK (patch 3.3.x) zone + transport dataset
meta.purpose: Authoritative source for the Evergrow world atlas (ticket T01). Positions, borders, cities, dungeons, docks, flight paths and transports for every WotLK zone.
conventions: borders: primary neighbor per cardinal direction, or null for ocean/impassable edge
bordersExtra: additional neighbors sharing that edge (adjacency is symmetric across borders+bordersExtra)
city/dungeon/dock/flightpath x,y: normalized 0..1 within the zone rect (0,0 = NW corner, y grows south)
widthKm/heightKm: approximate in-game footprint, for atlas rect sizing
faction: Alliance | Horde | Contested | Neutral | PvP (Wintergrasp)
transports: each route listed once; bidirectional unless marked false
durations: approximate real-time seconds matching WoW travel feel
dungeons: raid=true for raid instances; all are entrance placements
The Barrens is split into barrens-north / barrens-south per the atlas contract
Dalaran is a zone-level city inside crystalsong (it floats above the zone)
Isle of Quel'Danas is excluded (TBC daily isle, outside the four-continent atlas scope)

zones.name: Teldrassil
zones.notes: Island zone; reachable only by ship or the Rut'theran->Darnassus portal.

zones.name: The Barrens (North)
zones.notes: Northern half of the classic Barrens, split at roughly Camp Taurajo latitude.

zones.name: The Barrens (South)
zones.notes: Southern half of the classic Barrens; holds both Razorfen dungeons.

zones.name: Tanaris
zones.notes: Caverns of Time is a dungeon hub (Escape from Durnholde, Black Morass, Battle for Mount Hyjal).

zones.name: Felwood
zones.notes: Timbermaw Hold tunnels connect Felwood to both Moonglade and Winterspring.

zones.name: Moonglade
zones.notes: Druid-only flight routes to Darnassus (Alliance) and Thunder Bluff (Horde).

zones.name: Eastern Plaguelands
zones.notes: Naxxramas moved to Dragonblight in WotLK; Plaguewood ziggurat remains.

zones.name: Wetlands
zones.notes: Thandol Span is the north border crossing into Arathi.

zones.name: Burning Steppes
zones.notes: All Blackrock Mountain instances share the mountain interior at the NW corner.

zones.name: Deadwind Pass
zones.notes: No settlements or flight paths; Karazhan tower dominates the south.

zones.name: Sholazar Basin
zones.notes: Below-sea-level basin ringed by cliffs; accessed via avalanche paths.

zones.name: Icecrown
zones.notes: Tiered glacier terraces rising to Icecrown Citadel at the south wall.

zones.name: Crystalsong Forest

portals.name: Dalaran Portal to Caverns of Time

zones.notes: Dalaran floats above the zone; ground portal at Crystalsong links up.

zones.name: Wintergrasp
zones.notes: Outdoor PvP zone; no flight masters — reached via Dalaran portal or flying.

zones.name: Nagrand
zones.notes: Halaa is a capturable PvP town, no flight master.
